root_idea.summary: The root has several historically distinct lexical families. Its clearest productive thread concerns inclining or bending, especially turning something toward another; another major branch concerns giving a thing a distinctive form or shape.
root_idea.development: Maqayis explicitly cautions that many words under this root are not governed by one common derivational rule. The inclination branch extends to turning and bending, while the form branch yields forming, shaping, and the noun for a distinctive form; other nominal families remain independently lexical.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Distinct Quran-attested Form I imperative with reported incline, cut, and call interpretations in 2:260.
Distinct Quran-attested Form II verb meaning to form or fashion.
Quran-attested noun for form or distinctive constitution.
Distinct Quran-attested noun traditionally understood as the horn or trumpet.
Quran-attested active participle used as the divine epithet the Fashioner.

senses.definition: To turn or incline something toward oneself or another.
senses.usage_conditions: In 2:260, the imperative فَصُرْهُنَّ is commonly understood as “turn or incline them toward yourself.”

senses.definition: To cut or divide something into pieces.
senses.usage_conditions: A reported alternative interpretation of فَصُرْهُنَّ in 2:260 understands the command as cutting or dividing the birds into pieces.

senses.definition: To call or cry to them.
senses.usage_conditions: A less usual reported interpretation of the same Quranic command understands صُرْهُنَّ as “call or cry to them”; this is presented as an alternative reading or explanation, not the primary interpretation.

senses.definition: To form, fashion, shape, or give a distinctive form to something.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran this is used of divine formation and shaping, including formation in the womb and the giving of human beings their forms and distinguishing constitution.

senses.definition: A form, shape, or distinctive constitution by which a created being is recognizable; this may include outward form and distinguishing qualities.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic uses concern the forms in which human beings are created or constituted, including formation in the womb and the form assigned to each person.

senses.definition: A horn, especially the horn or trumpet blown at the resurrection.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrences refer to the blowing of the horn in eschatological scenes.

senses.definition: In a reported alternative interpretation, the collective plural of صُورَة: the forms of the dead into which spirits are blown.
senses.usage_conditions: This is a reported minority interpretation of the Quranic expression; the horn or trumpet interpretation is the primary one in the evidence.

senses.definition: One who forms or fashions; in the Quran, the divine Fashioner who gives existing things their distinctive forms and manner of being.
senses.usage_conditions: Used as a divine epithet in 59:24 and connected with the act of forming and distinguishing created things.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To demolish, throw down, or pull something down.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form I use, distinct from turning or inclining something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To decide or determine a judgment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension applied to a judge or judgment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To separate or disperse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported lexical sense attributed to the Kitab al-Adhdad.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To collect or gather.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A contrary reported lexical sense alongside “separate” or “disperse.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: To utter a cry or sound.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form I use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To incline, bend, or become crooked.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person, a neck, or a thing that leans or bends.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An inclination or desire toward someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of physical inclination.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become formed, fashioned, figured, shaped, sculptured, or pictured.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive or reflexive Form V counterpart to forming or shaping.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To imagine or conceive something as an image or form; in logical usage, to form a conception.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object may be mentally represented as an image, picture, or intelligible form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To incline and fall, or to fall or alight.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of someone struck or pierced and falling, and of a thing falling or alighting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become demolished, fall apart, crack, or split.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used intransitively of a thing or mountain that breaks down or divides.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To double, fold, or bend something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form VIII usage synonymous with folding or bending.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A group or cluster of small palm trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word is treated as having no ordinary singular of the same form; it may also refer to other trees in a group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The root or base of a palm tree or palm trunk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical or material sense distinct from the palm cluster.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The bank or side of a river or rivulet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A topographical noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The side of the neck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The forelock or frontal lock of hair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the hair at the front of the head, including a forelock described as inclining.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An itching affection of the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may refer to an itch or an affection producing the desire to be loused.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The head or uppermost part of a mountain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A geographical noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A palm tree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical noun distinct from the collective palm cluster.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An effigy, image, statue, picture, or other object formed in the likeness of a creature or thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This refers to a materially produced representation, distinct from the general notion of a form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mental image, resemblance, or idea formed or conceived in the mind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An abstract extension of the concrete image sense, frequent in philosophical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A species, kind, or type.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classificatory sense synonymous with نَوْع.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The essence, defining character, quality, property, or state by which a thing is what it is.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This abstract sense can denote a thing’s specific character or aggregate of attributes rather than its outward shape.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The mode or manner in which an action is performed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional abstract use referring to the manner or form of an action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The face.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical usage attested in traditional reports.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A herd of wild cattle, whether bulls or cows.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural is صِيرَانٌ; related vocalizations are also reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sweet or pleasant odor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A sensory noun, distinct from the specific musk-container sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A musk vesicle or container, a small quantity or piece of musk, or musk itself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Several closely related usages are reported, including the vessel containing musk and the substance in a small portion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The two corners of the mouth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dual anatomical expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Goodly in form or appearance; handsome.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally of a person’s appearance or form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sparrow that answers when called.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare zoological usage explicitly associated with responding to a call.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having an inclined, bent, or crooked neck; inclining the neck or face toward something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective describing bodily inclination or directed posture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Inclined or desirous toward a friend or object of love.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension with إِلَى indicating the object of inclination or desire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sculptor, painter, limner, or image-maker.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A human occupational sense, distinct from the divine Quranic epithet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An inclination or desire toward someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative noun use, including loving inclination toward a person or desire for an object.

cautions: The Form I imperative in 2:260 has competing reported interpretations: turning toward, cutting into pieces, and calling or crying to the birds.
صُور in the eschatological passages is primarily understood as the horn or trumpet; an alternative interpretation connects it with the plural of صُورَة.
The root entry contains multiple lexical families, and not every classical word listed under صور is necessarily derived from one unified semantic principle.
